source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 10ης Ιουνίου — «Άγιος Απολλώς»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 10 Ιουνίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing, and carries no years. The corpus already keeps an `apollos-under-julian`, whose Greek row is venerated on 25 January and whose page makes him a hermit and wonderworker under Julian the Apostate; this entry is a bishop who died in peace, and on the corpus's settled rule two entries on one calendar are two commemorations and so two men. The page has no asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence, and prints no hymn.
